macro.overnight_read: U.S. stocks mostly rose on Tuesday with the S&P 500 up 0.5% and Nasdaq up 1.1%, while crude oil moved lower by 1.5% and the Dollar index held firm near 121.32. Crypto sentiment remains neutral with Fear & Greed at 48, while upcoming FOMC and GDP data later this week are keeping overall market positioning cautious.
macro.summary: We are operating in a choppy, range-bound regime with a risk appetite of 65 ahead of a heavy macro calendar featuring the FOMC rate decision and GDP prints. We favor defensive and leading 20-day sectors like XLE, XLU, and KRE while avoiding lagging tech and communications names like SMH and XLC. Keep bucket weights at 50% core, 35% tactical, and 15% high-risk, focusing on mean reversion and strict risk management.
